## workflow assign

Assign an issue to someone, in Jira or on the forge

### Synopsis

Assign an issue to the person a username names: their Jira username for a
Jira issue, their forge login for a forge issue. The assignment is printed and
confirmed before it is made. A blank username is refused before anything is
asked.

```
workflow assign <issue> <username> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  workflow assign PROJ-7 bo --yes   # unattended
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for assign
  -y, --yes    go ahead without the confirmation
```

  -q, --quiet               say only warnings, errors and questions on stderr, leaving every note out
